capabilities: show .xmind files in the file explorer
preview the map image stored inside the archive
open files in the system default application
auto-detect the XMind executable path when file associations are broken
disambiguation: Not a mindmap viewer or editor; it never parses the XMind document and only shows the thumbnail stored in the file.
extras: Desktop only (Windows, macOS, Linux); opening files externally is not available on mobile. The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian only shows registered file extensions in the file explorer, quick switcher and search, so .xmind files are invisible in the vault.

relations.evidence: Hands the file to your operating system, so XMind starts as usual

summary: Adds .xmind files to the file explorer, previews their stored thumbnail image, and opens them in the system default app without parsing the mindmap.
